name: m6a-update-bad-signature
description: The bad-signature cases of M6a exit test 1 (docs/specs/m6a-updater.md, Tests, e2e), on an install of a VIMMA_UPDATES=1 tarball with the updater it ships (Vimma's certificates): a manifest signed by a key the build does not pin is refused before any download, and a manifest signed by the run's test key that offers a MAR signed with Mozilla's test key mycert is downloaded but refused by the updater (error 19), so the install stays on N.
